name: Node.js CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-15

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v1
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Cache node modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      env:
        cache-name: cache-node-modules
      with:
        # npm cache files are stored in `~/.npm` on Linux/macOS
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-build-
          ${{ runner.os }}-
              
    - name: Install Deps         
      run: make deps
    
    - name: Run Linter        
      run: make lint

    - name: Build TSC
      run: make build
    
    - name: Run CDK List
      run: make list

    - name: Run CDK Synth
      run: make test-all

      - name: Install dependencies

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint

      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
